name: yaps-video-to-audio
description: Convert a video to an MP3, WAV, or M4A audio file with Yaps.

interface.shortDescription: Convert video to MP3 or WAV
interface.longDescription: Convert a video file to MP3, WAV, or M4A audio with Yaps desktop. Choose the source video, output format, and destination; Yaps extracts the audio track locally and preserves existing files. Requires a local-capable ChatGPT Desktop Work or Codex session; ChatGPT web and cloud sessions cannot reach the installed Yaps engine. Users can also run the feature directly in Yaps.
defaultPrompt: Convert this video to an MP3 file.
Extract the audio from this video as WAV.
Turn this video into an M4A audio file.
